title: Journey for Architecting a Nimble Organization
description: Horizon's operating model advances through four maturity stages toward autonomous delivery, with a 60/90/180-day transformation timeline.
speakerNotes: Four maturity stages: Traditional Ops (100% legacy baseline, being retired), Automation-Led Ops (63% to 80% target, Platform Engineering), AI-Augmented Ops (41% to 78% target, AI Transformation Office), Autonomous Ops (12% to 95% target, Joint IBM x Horizon). 391 resources across 11 domains, 15 portfolios, 28 products.

title: Cultural Change
description: Operations shift from reactive and manual to AI-assisted and proactive across five From-To pairs, with a 60/90/180-day timeline.
speakerNotes: Five From to To shifts drawn from workforce transformation data: manual triage to 95% auto-remediation; reactive to proactive anomaly detection; high FTE dependency to 124 FTEs redeployed; siloed tools to unified Command Center with GenAI Copilot; days to 5-minute MTTR for enrollment errors. 382 certified resources, 450+ planned certifications, 41% AI-enabled.

title: Pod & Product Model Evolution: CareOps
description: CareOps (CareRadius) is the blueprint for evolving the organization into a product and pod model — a standing pod owning build, run, and AI uplift, with three real modernization initiatives and a 60/90/180-day timeline.
speakerNotes: CareOps (CareRadius) is the blueprint for evolving the org into the product and pod model. CareRadius Clinical Ops pod, ~30 resources. Three real initiatives: SAP BO 4.2 to 4.3 (Active Sep-Dec), Angular 11 to 17 (Active Oct-Jan), VB6 to .NET 8 (Planned Nov-Apr, 60% fewer legacy tickets).

title: First Six Months — Monthly Transformation Plan
description: The first six months sequence quick wins, modernization, and ticket reduction across 60 initiatives in three tracks.
speakerNotes: Contract starts in August. Aug quick wins; Sep modernization ramp; Oct AI foundations; Nov scale automation; Dec payments & remittance; Jan consolidate. 60 initiatives: 25 technical remediation, 16 transformation, 19 ticket reduction. This slide is itself a timeline so it carries no separate timeline band.

title: Governance & Delivery Management
description: Governance cadences keep the transformation on plan and value on track across six value-impact areas, with a 60/90/180-day timeline.
speakerNotes: Five governance practices with cadence and owner. Six value-impact areas (no dollar figures): Automation (70% manual work eliminated), Data (real-time processing), Integration (faster partner onboarding), AI/GenAI (95% auto-remediation), AIOps (13.5 hrs to 5 min resolution), Domain (compliance & accuracy).

title: Asks from Horizon
description: Six commitments from Horizon keep the six-month roadmap on track by converting at-risk dependencies into shared accountability.
speakerNotes: Six asks tied to real roadmap dependencies: exec sponsorship; SME/product-owner access; data governance ownership (unblocks Member Data Hub MDM ~180 tickets/mo); vendor coordination (NASCO, Premium Rating, SAP ~80 tickets/mo at risk); timely approvals; certification time (450+ planned). No timeline band.
